azapi_resource.diag_settings writes diagnostic settings whose workspaceId (via local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id) is a string computed inside module.management_resources from coalesce() of plain values — no attribute reference reaches azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management, so nothing guarantees the Log Analytics workspace exists before the diagnostic settings are created. If the workspace is created in the same apply, the azapi_resource call can fail or point at a non-existent workspace.

azurerm_role_assignment.policy_assignment exists to create role assignments for the managed identities of Policy Assignments (issue #266 workaround, kept for the v2.0.0 upgrade path). Creating a role assignment for a policy assignment's principal_id requires that policy assignment (and its SystemAssigned identity) to already exist, but the resource has no dependency — implicit or explicit — on azurerm_management_group_policy_assignment.enterprise_scale. (Note the resource is currently iterated over local.empty_map, so impact is limited until it is re-enabled.)
